thresholdsPrimary._what: the PASS/FAIL criteria: relative drops measured in the SAME conditions (machine, scenario, window length), plus the absolute guards that do NOT depend on the contaminated batch.

p0_instances.note: every scenario, every window; >1 is FAIL. Judged from experiments/probe-instances.mjs, which may only be believed when its `determination` is CAPTURED (a dead detector previously produced instances=0).

p0_applyPerS.note: both: relative drop versus the same-condition BEFORE run, and an absolute ceiling that does not come from the contaminated batch

p0_themeChangePerS.note: derived as applyPerS / liveInstanceCount; only meaningful once p0_instances is verified

p1_rafOver50.note: relative drop of long frames per 2 windows versus the same-condition BEFORE run

p1_rafP50.note: SENTINEL. The baseline is 16.7 ms everywhere; a WORSE p50 is a FAIL even if p99 improves. Absolute on purpose: this is the 'nothing broke' gate, not a 'got better' gate.

p1_nodes.note: a >5% DOM-node difference makes the windows incomparable => INCONCLUSIVE

p1_reconcileRatio.note: instrument sanity, not a performance threshold

thresholdsReference._what: reported for context and NOT enforced unless the comparison is run with --enforce-reference. Each entry records where its number came from.

recalcOverTask.provenance: audit §4.2, derived from the CONTAMINATED cpuL batch ('from 60.0%'). The coordinator's clean measurement already sits at 31-35%, so the 60%->15% framing does not apply to a clean BEFORE/AFTER pair.

applyShareOfBusy.provenance: audit §4.2, derived from the CONTAMINATED cpuL batch ('from 0.50-0.80').

taskMsPerS.provenance: audit §4.2; relative, but the task denominator carries unrelated work, so it stays advisory until the M-B/M-C separation lands.

rafPerS.provenance: audit §4.2 baseline 35.6-49/s, itself a contended-machine number (a clean page runs ~60/s). Absolute and baseline-derived.

rafP99.provenance: audit §4.2 baseline 50-133 ms, from the contaminated batch.

longTasks.note: audit §4.2 sets no hard threshold because the baseline swings 0-18; reported only.
